subject: Simulating a process where units are consolidated (packaged)

messages.author: 32ca34ebc225cb13
messages.subject: Simulating a process where units are consolidated (packaged)
parts:
I am very new to simmer but familiar with R.  Thus far the package has been excellent in understanding the the front end of the apple packing operation.

I am trying to run a simluation whereby the basic units are apples.  These apples are graded and sorted by diameter (which I have done successfully - using multiple branches).  The next step is they enter a queue (accumulation) and get packaged into tubes (3,4 and 5 apples per tube depending on the size).  These are then packaged into shipping cartons (16 tubes per carton).  The cartons are palletised and the pallets loaded into shipping cartons.

My question is how do I trigger an arrival of a tube to shipping carton to pallet (128 cartons per pallet) and the shipping container (21 pallets per container) (I feel that using a if loop with a modulus approach would work but am unsure how to code it within a trajectory?)  I have attached my code below for reference.  Just a general approach to consolidated units would be useful for me at this stage.

Best regards
Stuart Dykes

library(simmer)

env <- simmer()

set.seed(1234)

traj <- trajectory() %>%
#
# assign a diameter as a trribute to each arrival
#
  set_attribute("diameter",function() rnorm(1,58.3,5.2)) %>%
#
# This intial branch partitions off the 15% rejects which go for juicing
#
  branch(
    option=function() sample(c(1, 2), 1, prob=c(0.85, 0.15)), continue=c(T,F),
    trajectory("export") %>% 
      seize("INV_export",1) %>%
      timeout(function() (0.05)) %>%
      release("INV_export",1),
    trajectory("reject") %>% 
      seize("INV_reject",1) %>%
      timeout(function() (0.05)) %>%
      release("INV_reject",1)
  ) %>%
#  
# Send the apples to their appropriate drop based on their diameter
#  
  branch(
    option= function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=71.6) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
    trajectory("oversize_apples") %>% 
      seize("os_packline",1) %>%
      timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
      release("os_packline",1),
    trajectory("smaller_apples_1") %>%
      branch(
        function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=65.3) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
        trajectory("72_tube_drop") %>%
          seize("72/4_packline",1) %>%
          timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
          release("72/4_packline",1) %>%
          count72 <- count72 + 1,
        trajectory("smaller_apples_2") %>%
          branch(
            function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=60.8) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
            trajectory("67_tube_drop") %>%
              seize("67/4/5_packline",1) %>%
              timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
              release("67/4/5_packline",1),
            trajectory("smaller_apples_3") %>%
              branch(
                function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=59.6) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
                trajectory("63/4_tube_drop") %>%
                  seize("63/4_packline",1) %>%
                  timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                  release("63/4_packline",1),
                trajectory("smaller_apples_4") %>%
                  branch(
                    function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=56.1) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
                    trajectory("63/0/3/5T_tube_drop") %>%
                      seize("63/0/3/5T_packline",1) %>%
                      timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                      release("63/0/3/5T_packline",1),
                    trajectory("smaller_apples_5") %>%
                      branch(
                        function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=55) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
                        trajectory("63/5_tube_drop") %>%
                          seize("63/5_packline",1) %>%
                          timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                          release("63/5_packline",1),
                        trajectory("smaller_apples_5") %>%
                          branch(
                            function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=50.6) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
                            trajectory("58/5_tube_drop") %>%
                              seize("58/5_packline",1) %>%
                              timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                              release("58/5_packline",1),
                            trajectory("smaller_apples_6") %>%
                              branch(
                                function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=45.9) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
                                trajectory("53/5_tube_drop") %>%
                                  seize("53/5_packline",1) %>%
                                  timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                                  release("53/5_packline",1),
                                trajectory("undersize_apples") %>%
                                  seize("us_packline",1) %>%
                                  timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>% 
                                  release("us_packline",1)
                              ) 
                          ) 
                      ) 
                  ) 
              ) 
          ) 
      ) 
  ) 
#
env %>%
#
  add_resource("os_packline",1) %>%
  add_resource("72/4_packline",1) %>%
  add_resource("67/4/5_packline",3) %>%
  add_resource("63/4_packline",1) %>%
  add_resource("63/0/3/5T_packline",4) %>%
  add_resource("63/5_packline",1) %>%
  add_resource("58/5_packline",2) %>%
  add_resource("53/5_packline",1) %>%
  add_resource("us_packline",1) %>%
#  
  add_resource("INV_export", 1) %>%
  add_resource("INV_reject", 1) %>%
  add_generator("apple", traj, at(seq(0,100,by=0.0625)),mon=2) 
#
env %>%
 run() %>% invisible

arrivals <- get_mon_arrivals(env, per_resource = T)
attribute <- get_mon_attributes(env)
resources <- get_mon_resources(env)

table(arrivals$resource)
#
capture.output(env)

>> > timeout(function() (0.05)) %>%

>> > timeout(function() (0.05)) %>%
>> > release("INV_reject",1)
>> > ) %>%
>> > #

>> > trajectory("oversize_apples") %>%
>> > seize("os_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("os_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_1") %>%
>> > branch(

>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("72/4_packline",1) %>%
>> > count72 <- count72 + 1,
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_2") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=60.8) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("67_tube_drop") %>%

>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("67/4/5_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_3") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=59.6) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("63/4_tube_drop") %>%
>> > seize("63/4_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("63/4_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_4") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=56.1) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("63/0/3/5T_tube_drop") %>%
>> > seize("63/0/3/5T_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("63/0/3/5T_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_5") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=55) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("63/5_tube_drop") %>%
>> > seize("63/5_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("63/5_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_5") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=50.6) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("58/5_tube_drop") %>%
>> > seize("58/5_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("58/5_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("smaller_apples_6") %>%
>> > branch(
>> > function() if(get_attribute(env,"diameter") >=45.9) 1 else 2, continue=c(T,T),
>> > trajectory("53/5_tube_drop") %>%
>> > seize("53/5_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("53/5_packline",1),
>> > trajectory("undersize_apples") %>%
>> > seize("us_packline",1) %>%
>> > timeout(function() rnorm(1, 0.8, .2)) %>%
>> > release("us_packline",1)
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )
>> > )

>
> This is great and gives me what I need. I wonder whether there is a way of identifying the individual batches for further downstream consolidation into cartons, pallets and containers?

By design, any process not defined by the user does not appear in the
output (i.e., get_mon_arrivals), which includes batches. To account
for individual batches, I would use global attributes (see
set_global). Some examples here (not related to batches though):

https://r-simmer.org/articles/simmer-03-trajectories.html#set_attribute-set_global

Iñaki
